title: Derived duality for perfect complexes
statement: Let $B$ be a commutative ring and let $C\in D(B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] be perfect [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex], meaning represented by a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $B$-modules [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Then $R\operatorname{Hom}_B(C,B)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] is perfect, and the canonical evaluation map $C\to R\operatorname{Hom}_B(R\operatorname{Hom}_B(C,B),B)$ is an isomorphism in $D(B).$

source.place: Tag 07VI, lemma-dual-perfect-complex (the bounded finite-projective Hom model and signed double-dual evaluation).
